description: RFC 0080 core builtin control. Same bytes as the fixture, module NOT loaded, but the host holds the declaration out of band. The RFC 0003 resolution path on a PRODUCT module rather than the com.example fixture: degraded via the industrial fallback, MOD-FALLBACK-001, and no display name - a cached declaration can only ever degrade, never resolve. Nothing from the module runs, because nothing from the module is loaded.
